description: Canonical GES Application Registry. This file inventories platform applications, tools, page families, internal modules, reporting systems, knowledge systems, experiments, and future county-deployable modules.

applications.title: Guided Parcel Review
applications.description: Parcel-specific taxpayer review workspace for confirming record facts, reviewing value and tax movement, capturing questions, and generating summaries.

searchable.notes: Future public search should expose public parcel summaries only, not local notes or internal diagnostics.

applications.title: Project Home
applications.description: Current launch page for GPR, articles, tools, experiments, and field workflows.

applications.title: Article Roll
applications.description: Public and internal listing of GES articles backed by the article manifest.

applications.title: GES Articles
applications.description: Article content family. Individual article records remain in the article manifest until publication objects move to the Knowledge Platform or SQL.

applications.title: Public Page Family
applications.description: Public informational page family for About, FAQ, Contact, Administrative, and future public pages.

searchable.notes: Placeholder pages should become searchable only after content matures.

applications.title: About GES
applications.description: Public about page for Guided Parcel Review and the Guided Editorial System.

applications.title: FAQ
applications.description: Public frequently asked questions page. Current route is a placeholder while step-specific FAQs remain in GPR resources.

searchable.notes: Search after FAQ entries are promoted from route resources to knowledge objects.

applications.title: Contact
applications.description: Public contact guidance page. Current route is a placeholder.

applications.title: Administrative Page
applications.description: Public administrative notices, policies, accessibility information, copyright, and source/data notices.

applications.title: Minimal Pages and Error States
applications.description: Minimal layout family for 404, recovery, unavailable, and low-chrome states.

applications.title: Resources
applications.description: Future public resource hub and current route-specific resource system for FAQs, forms, dates, policies, and related links.

searchable.notes: Should index promoted resources, not transient footer UI.

metadata.currentRepresentation: GPR footer resources and route resources

applications.title: Knowledge Platform
applications.description: Structured reusable definitions, statutes, standards, procedures, deadlines, forms, source records, formulas, facts, and relationships.

applications.title: Glossary
applications.description: Public and internal glossary surface for assessment, equalization, tax, legal, and record-card terms.

metadata.seedSource: IAAO glossary plus GPR content extraction

applications.title: Assessment Calendar
applications.description: Public and internal assessment deadlines, taxpayer action dates, PAD calendar events, and future workflow windows.

metadata.currentRepresentation: assessment dates modal and workspace calendar seeds

applications.title: GES Search
applications.description: Future central search service across articles, knowledge objects, glossary, resources, calendar, public tools, and permission-aware internal objects.

searchable.notes: Search is the index consumer, not something that indexes itself.

metadata.currentRepresentation: article roll typeahead and parcel switcher search are separate local implementations

applications.title: Public Tools
applications.description: Public tools and calculators extracted from GPR, articles, and experiments.

applications.title: Property Tax Calculator
applications.description: Future public calculator for assessed value, levy, gross tax, credits, net tax, and movement scenarios.
dataSources: tax statement data from selected parcel

applications.title: Tax District Explorer
applications.description: Future public explorer for tax districts, authorities, levy components, shares, and source notes.

applications.title: Equalization Metrics Explorer
applications.description: Future public article-embedded or standalone explainer for COD, PRD, COV, level of value, and ratio-study context.

applications.title: County CTL Comparison
applications.description: Future public statewide CTL explorer for county value, tax, and average rate trends.

applications.title: Reporting Engine
applications.description: Future shared report system for conversation summaries, correction packets, assessor reports, board reports, printable summaries, PDFs, and QR-enabled reports.

searchable.notes: Report metadata may be searchable internally later; generated reports are not public search content by default.

applications.title: PDF Generation
applications.description: Current browser PDF generation utilities and future PDF layout/rendering capability.

applications.title: QR Generation
applications.description: Future QR-enabled public parcel summaries, article resources, reports, and printable artifacts.

applications.title: Assessor Workspace
applications.description: Future authenticated assessor workspace for agenda, calendar, pinned knowledge, recent parcels, tools, articles, reports, and workflow attention.

applications.title: Internal Dashboard
applications.description: Future authenticated dashboard family for assessor diagnostics, valuation groups, workflow reporting, and operational summaries.

applications.title: BOE Protest Tracker
applications.description: Local-first Board of Equalization hearing observation, queue, export, and sync workspace.

searchable.notes: Local hearing records should not enter public search.

permissions.currentPermissionConcern: Route is directly accessible if URL is known.

applications.title: Experiments
applications.description: Current experimental route family and static lab pages for prototype workflows, visualizations, and concepts.

applications.title: Loaded Property Invite Index
applications.description: Experimental loaded-property invite/index view.

applications.title: Comparable Review Experiments
applications.description: Experimental comparable property walkthroughs and candidate review aids.

applications.title: Valuation Group Labs
applications.description: Static experimental valuation group overview and aggregate lab pages.

applications.title: GES Pattern Library
applications.description: GES 1.0 style guide, design-system pattern library, tokens, components, and examples.

applications.title: GES Public Layout
applications.description: Shared public layout, metadata, footer, and shell behavior for public pages, articles, and tools.

applications.title: County Deployment Tools
applications.description: Future tooling for county-specific deployment, branding, data-source registration, enabled apps, and tenant configuration.
